units.source_text: 马咯依旧沉着镇静地将托喀的诗稿递给怒发冲冠库拉巴喀。

en.t: Mag calmly handed Tock's manuscript to the furious Craback.

units.source_text: 库拉巴喀全神贯注地读那篇诗稿。

en.t: Craback read the manuscript with complete concentration.

units.source_text: 马咯跟他讲话，他也爱答不理的。

en.t: Even when Mag spoke to him, he barely answered.
